findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_local_workers, get_worker_profile, get_work_record, find_work_clips, check_job_price, check_what_to_charge, draft_job_post, ask_local_for_a_hand, get_platform_info · Private data: get_work_record · Public sink: draft_job_post, ask_local_for_a_hand, get_area_demand_density · Destructive: draft_job_post, ask_local_for_a_hand.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_local_workers, get_worker_profile, get_work_record, find_work_clips, check_job_price, check_what_to_charge, draft_job_post, ask_local_for_a_hand, get_platform_info · Private data: get_work_record · Public sink: draft_job_post, ask_local_for_a_hand, get_area_demand_density · Destructive: draft_job_post, ask_local_for_a_hand

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
